finding: Before packing meat or milk products for Norway, check the origin-based exceptions: personal consignments from countries outside the EU/EEA are generally prohibited, with limited exceptions including qualifying infant/medical foods, products from specified countries, and rules for the Faroe Islands and Greenland. Up to 1 kg of other animal-origin foods may be brought without veterinary control. Surrender non-compliant items; failure to declare may lead to prosecution.
jurisdiction_scope: Personal food imports carried by travellers entering Norway; product and origin exceptions apply.
authority: Norwegian Food Safety Authority (Mattilsynet)
open_questions: Verify the exact product, origin, quantity and any current exception before travel; this finding does not cover plant-product rules.

finding: Before packing food, plants or animal products for Argentina, check SENASA's current permitted and prohibited lists. The official traveller guidance lists fresh produce, plants, homemade food, many meats and processed meat products, honey, dairy products and unlabeled food among items not permitted, while some factory-packed and labeled foods are allowed in personal-use quantities. Non-compliant goods may be seized; exceptions depend on the exact product and origin.
jurisdiction_scope: Travellers entering or returning to Argentina with food, plants, animals or agricultural products.
authority: National Service of Agri-Food Health and Quality (SENASA), Argentina
open_questions: The allowed list is product- and origin-specific and is updated by resolutions; check the current rule for the exact item before packing.

finding: Before bringing plant-origin material or souvenirs into Costa Rica, check with the State Phytosanitary Service (SFE). It warns that plant-fibre crafts and materials such as coconut or banana fibre, wicker, straw and seeds may be seized and destroyed if they lack prior SFE risk-analysis approval. Check the exact item's origin, presentation and approval before travel or online purchase.
jurisdiction_scope: Personal passenger baggage and individual purchases of plant-origin material entering Costa Rica; the warning also discusses online purchases.
authority: State Phytosanitary Service (SFE), Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock of Costa Rica
open_questions: The source is specific to plant-origin materials and does not establish animal-product rules or a universal ban on all crafts.

finding: When entering or leaving Qatar with currency, bearer negotiable instruments, precious metals or precious stones totaling QAR 50,000 or more (or the equivalent in another currency), submit a Customs Declaration Form at the customs declaration office at an air, sea or land outlet. This is a threshold-triggered declaration, not a form required of every arriving passenger.
jurisdiction_scope: Persons entering or leaving Qatar with the specified currency or valuables at or above the threshold; all travel outlets.
authority: General Authority of Customs, Qatar
open_questions: Confirm how values are calculated for mixed items/currencies and check the current declaration process before travel.
proposed_traveler_alert: Declare covered cash, bearer instruments, precious metals or stones worth QAR 50,000 or more when entering or leaving Qatar. Confirm what counts toward the threshold with Qatar Customs.

finding: Do not bring fresh fruit into Sri Lanka in personal baggage on an air arrival. Other plant material, including plant parts, seeds and dried fruit, is restricted and needs prior approval; exotic plants also require a prior Plant Quarantine permit and phytosanitary certificate. Animals require prior Animal Quarantine approval and a quarantine certificate. Check the exact item with the relevant unit before packing.
jurisdiction_scope: Personal baggage entering Sri Lanka by air; item-specific plant and animal controls apply.
authority: Sri Lanka Customs; Plant Quarantine and Animal Quarantine units
open_questions: The page lists specific plant-family restrictions and exceptions. Confirm the exact item and permit process; this does not establish rules for all processed foods.

finding: Sri Lanka Customs says currency exceeding USD 15,000 equivalent must be declared on entry. On departure, currency exceeding USD 10,000 equivalent must be declared; any amount below USD 15,000 that was previously declared must also be declared if being taken back out. These thresholds concern currency, not every type of financial instrument.
jurisdiction_scope: Passengers bringing currency into or taking currency out of Sri Lanka.
authority: Sri Lanka Customs
open_questions: Confirm the current declaration procedure and how the Customs authority values mixed currencies before travel.

finding: Sri Lanka Customs hosts a process flow for clearance of drones or UAVs and says the instructions were provided by the Telecommunications Regulatory Commission. Before carrying a drone into Sri Lanka, confirm with Customs and TRCSL which clearances apply to the model and to a visitor's baggage. This is an import-clearance alert, not permission to fly the drone.
jurisdiction_scope: Potential drone or UAV import/clearance into Sri Lanka; visitor applicability is not established by the notice.
authority: Sri Lanka Customs; Telecommunications Regulatory Commission of Sri Lanka (TRCSL)
open_questions: The notice points to a 2021 process-flow document. Currentness, exact approvals, model scope and applicability to passenger baggage or non-residents remain unverified; confirm with the authorities before travel.

finding: Before packing food, plants or soil for Peru, check SENASA's traveller rules and declare animal-origin products. Only authorized animal products may enter, with product, origin, packaging and quantity limits; pork products are prohibited. Many fresh or naturally dried fruits and flowers, plants and plant parts require prior SENASA authorization, and soil or earth is not authorized. Declare plant products and check the exact item before travel.
jurisdiction_scope: Passengers entering Peru with accompanied baggage containing animal- or plant-origin products or soil.
authority: National Agrarian Health Service of Peru (SENASA)
open_questions: The traveller page was last changed 2024-05-10. Check current product/origin restrictions and obtain any required authorization before travel.

finding: For personal imports into Switzerland, animal-origin products are generally permitted only from EU member states, Iceland, Northern Ireland and Norway; imports from other countries are generally prohibited. Narrow food exceptions and separate animal/CITES rules apply, so check the exact product and origin before packing. A customs duty-free quantity is not, by itself, permission to import a prohibited product.
jurisdiction_scope: Animal-origin products carried for private use by travellers entering Switzerland; product-specific exceptions apply.
authority: Federal Office for Customs and Border Security (BAZG), Switzerland
open_questions: Check the Federal Food Safety and Veterinary Office's current exceptions for the exact product and origin; this finding does not cover plant products.

finding: India's official visa portal states that foreign nationals need a valid passport and an Indian visa or eVisa, with qualifying OCI/eOCI documents and bilateral exemptions treated separately. Check eligibility for the traveler's nationality, passport type and intended port before booking.
jurisdiction_scope: Foreign nationals entering India; exemptions and permitted visa categories depend on nationality and travel document.
authority: Ministry of Home Affairs, Bureau of Immigration (India Visa Online)
open_questions: The official portal could not be loaded directly during this pass; verify nationality-specific requirements and eligible ports on the live site.

finding: India's official visa portal says foreign nationals and OCI/eOCI cardholders must submit an e-Arrival Card. Confirm the current submission window and whether any separate Air Suvidha declaration is still required before departure; the e-Arrival application loaded only as a JavaScript shell during this check.
jurisdiction_scope: Foreign nationals and OCI/eOCI cardholders arriving in India; form timing and any additional declaration remain unresolved.
authority: Ministry of Home Affairs, Bureau of Immigration (India Visa Online)
open_questions: Official indexed text also refers to Air Suvidha, but its present applicability was not established. Do not state a 72-hour deadline until confirmed from current primary instructions.

finding: If the route includes a country on India's current yellow-fever-endemic list, check the certificate requirement before travel. India's port-health authority says passengers travelling to and from endemic countries need a valid Yellow Fever Vaccination Certificate; the certificate becomes valid 10 days after vaccination. A missing or defective certificate can result in quarantine for up to six days or until it becomes valid.
jurisdiction_scope: Passengers travelling to or from countries on India's current yellow-fever-endemic list; check the current country list and applicable age exceptions.
authority: Integrated Health Information Platform for Overseas Health, Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, India
open_questions: The current endemic-country list and age exceptions were not reviewed. Confirm the exact route against the latest official list.

finding: Before carrying a narcotic or psychotropic medicine into India, check the Central Bureau of Narcotics' special provisions for international travellers and carry supporting medical documentation. The Bureau posted a traveler notice on 17 October 2026, but the linked PDF was not readable in this pass; do not rely on a quantity limit until the exact rule is confirmed.
jurisdiction_scope: International travellers carrying narcotic or psychotropic medicines for personal medical use in India.
authority: Central Bureau of Narcotics, Department of Revenue, India
open_questions: The notice exists on the official CBN site, but substance lists, permitted quantities, prescription requirements and prior-approval conditions need confirmation from the readable circular.

finding: CBIC's 2026 baggage update says passengers carrying dutiable or prohibited goods must submit an electronic customs declaration before entering the Green Channel. Check the current electronic form and your item's allowance or permit status before arrival; the 2026 rules supersede the earlier baggage framework.
jurisdiction_scope: Passengers arriving in India with dutiable or prohibited goods; the 2026 declaration process applies to the stated goods.
authority: Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs (CBIC), India
open_questions: The CBIC page rendered only a shell during this check. Confirm the current form, allowances and effective notification directly before publishing a definitive traveler rule.

finding: Before packing meat, dairy, fish, poultry, seeds, plants, fruit or flowers for India, check current Customs and quarantine conditions and declare items when required. CBIC's passenger declaration form flags these item classes, but the current 2026 permit and allowance details were not verified.
jurisdiction_scope: Passenger baggage entering India with animal- or plant-origin items; exact product and quarantine rules remain unconfirmed.
authority: CBIC, India; Plant Quarantine and Animal Quarantine authorities
open_questions: The item list came from the official form's indexed text; verify that this form remains current under the 2026 baggage rules and confirm item-specific permits or prohibitions.

finding: CBIC's indexed passenger declaration form flags foreign currency notes above USD 5,000 or aggregate foreign exchange above USD 10,000 for declaration. Before carrying amounts near or above these thresholds, verify the current declaration requirements under the 2026 baggage rules.
jurisdiction_scope: Passengers entering India carrying foreign currency; cash-note and aggregate-foreign-exchange thresholds are distinct.
authority: CBIC, India
open_questions: The form's indexed text was not directly readable and the 2026 rules superseded the prior baggage framework; confirm the current thresholds and form before treating these figures as definitive.

finding: Before operating a drone in India, check DGCA/Digital Sky airspace-zone and permission requirements for the exact location and aircraft. Official rules distinguish green, yellow and red zones, but foreign-visitor operating eligibility was not established here. Import restrictions are separate from permission to fly.
jurisdiction_scope: Drone operation within India; location, aircraft class and operator eligibility affect requirements.
authority: Directorate General of Civil Aviation (DGCA), India
open_questions: Verify the current zone map, registration/operator requirements and any rules for foreign nationals from an official DGCA source; do not reuse the separate import restriction as an operating rule.

finding: Saudi Arabia's Interior Ministry launched Absher Travel for Visitors for GCC nationals and other visitors arriving through land border crossings. It collects traveler and vehicle details and vehicle insurance before arrival; the Ministry says it will become mandatory six months after launch on 26 October 2026, approximately 26 April 2027. This does not apply to air arrivals.
jurisdiction_scope: GCC nationals and other visitors arriving at Saudi land border crossings; future mandatory date is approximately 26 April 2027.
authority: Saudi Ministry of Interior, reported by the Saudi Press Agency
open_questions: Confirm the exact effective date and current optional/mandatory status before travel. Do not generalize this land-border process to air passengers.

finding: Egypt Customs' passenger page says new personal-use goods and gifts above EGP 1,500 exceed the stated exemption and should use the red channel; other conditions apply to the passenger allowance. Verify the current allowance and declaration route with Customs before packing valuable or newly purchased goods.
jurisdiction_scope: Tourists, transit travellers and residents arriving in Egypt, as described by the Customs passenger page.
authority: Egyptian Customs Authority
open_questions: The page is hosted on a nonstandard Azure subdomain and has no visible publication date. Confirm its currentness and canonical authority before presenting EGP 1,500 as a controlling limit.

finding: Egypt Customs' passenger page says foreign cash above USD 10,000 must be declared and Egyptian currency is limited to EGP 5,000 on arrival and departure. Check the current limits and declaration route before carrying cash near these amounts.
jurisdiction_scope: Passengers arriving in or departing from Egypt carrying foreign or Egyptian currency.
authority: Egyptian Customs Authority
open_questions: The page is hosted on a nonstandard Azure subdomain and is undated. Confirm current thresholds, passenger scope and any Central Bank conditions on a canonical current Customs source.

finding: Check Korea's current quarantine-area list before travel. KDCA requires a Q-CODE or paper health declaration for arrivals who visited, stayed in or transited through a Focused Quarantine Management Area; arrivals from other Quarantine Management Areas must declare if symptomatic, such as with fever or cough. Q-CODE can be submitted from seven days before arrival, and a new code is needed for each entry.
jurisdiction_scope: All arrivals to South Korea; declaration is triggered by recent travel through designated areas or symptoms.
authority: Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency (KDCA)
open_questions: The current country/area list and any disease-specific certificate requirements were not checked; verify them before each trip.

finding: Vietnam's Government portal reports that health declarations at borders are not routinely mandatory for every traveller; the Ministry of Health may require them for specific diseases and risk periods. If required, the declaration may be electronic or paper and is submitted within seven days before crossing. The Ministry said tokhaiyte.vn was not in use and that it would announce any active system.
jurisdiction_scope: People entering, leaving or transiting Vietnam; requirements depend on disease-specific Ministry of Health notices.
authority: Government of Vietnam news portal, quoting the Ministry of Health's Deputy Director of the Department of Preventive Medicine
open_questions: The source is dated 30 June 2026. Check for any later disease-specific notice or replacement declaration system before travel; do not direct travellers to tokhaiyte.vn based on older pages.

finding: Vietnam Customs publishes a traveller declaration process for goods and valuables that require declaration. If carrying restricted or dutiable goods, cash or valuables, verify the current form and applicable allowance before using the Green Channel; the exact goods limits were not confirmed in this pass.
jurisdiction_scope: Travellers entering or leaving Vietnam with items subject to customs declaration.
authority: General Department of Vietnam Customs
open_questions: The official page could not be opened directly and the available indexed text is incomplete. Confirm current form, allowances and item-specific rules from a readable Customs source.

finding: Vietnam Customs' indexed traveller guidance says cash above USD 5,000 equivalent or VND 15,000,000 must be declared on entry or exit. For departure with cash above the threshold or above the amount declared on the latest entry, supporting entry/declaration or bank documents may be required. Confirm current route-specific instructions before travel.
jurisdiction_scope: Individuals entering or leaving Vietnam through international border gates with foreign or Vietnamese currency in cash; traveler cheques and bank cards are excluded in the indexed guidance.
authority: General Department of Vietnam Customs
open_questions: The official Customs page could not be opened directly. Verify the thresholds, the exact exit-document rules and any later amendments before treating this as definitive.

finding: Before carrying prescription medicines into Indonesia, especially psychotropic medicines, confirm the applicable personal-import limits and documents with BPOM or Customs. An official BPOM regional PDF appears to cover personal-use medicines, but its text was unreadable and a secondary account conflicts on psychotropics; do not rely on a 90-day limit until the primary rule is verified.
jurisdiction_scope: Passengers arriving in Indonesia with medicines for personal use, particularly controlled medicines.
authority: Food and Drug Supervisory Agency (BPOM), Pekanbaru regional office
open_questions: The linked PDF was not readable; verify the exact medicine class, quantity, prescription, authorization and current rule with BPOM. The snippet-only 90-day figure is not adopted as a confirmed limit.

finding: Declare animal, fish and plant commodities and their products through All Indonesia and report them to quarantine officers on arrival. Indonesia's quarantine authority warns that processed products can still carry disease risks and may be inspected or held; check item-specific permission before packing them.
jurisdiction_scope: Passengers bringing animal, fish or plant commodities and derived products into Indonesia in baggage.
authority: Indonesian Quarantine Agency (Badan Karantina Indonesia)
open_questions: The source requires reporting but does not give a complete product list or quantity allowances. Check current quarantine conditions for the exact item and country of origin.

finding: Indonesia Customs says travellers carrying cash or payment instruments worth Rp 100,000,000 or more, or foreign banknotes worth at least Rp 1,000,000,000, must notify Customs. Air/sea arrivals use All Indonesia; land arrivals and qualifying outbound trips use the Customs ECD route. Check the route-specific form before travel.
jurisdiction_scope: Passengers entering or leaving Indonesia with cash or specified payment instruments; form channel differs by mode and direction.
authority: Directorate General of Customs and Excise, Indonesia
open_questions: Confirm how the thresholds apply to each border mode and the current form prompts. The official page describes the ECD route specifically for land arrivals and qualifying departures.

finding: Greece prohibits smoking and related products, including e-cigarettes, in covered workplaces, food-service interiors, indoor waiting spaces, airports except designated areas, public transport, and other listed venues. Follow venue signs and check local exceptions.
jurisdiction_scope: Nationwide in the listed spaces; the source does not establish a general outdoor smoking ban.
authority: Ministry of Health, Greece
open_questions: Confirm current enforcement and venue-specific exceptions before publication; source lists statutory venue categories.

finding: If visiting Mount Athos, arrange the personal diamonitirion entry permit in advance through the Pilgrims' Bureau. Visitor numbers are capped and women are not admitted under the Mount Athos access regime; confirm current eligibility and permit conditions before travel.
jurisdiction_scope: Mount Athos only; reported to apply to visitors regardless of nationality.
authority: Mount Athos travel information; institutional status not confirmed
open_questions: Confirm the current quota, eligibility, permit validity and application process with the Pilgrims' Bureau or Holy Community; the cited publisher's official status is unconfirmed.

finding: Austria's anti-face-covering law prohibits hiding facial features in public places, including public transport, subject to statutory exceptions such as health, work, sport, artistic or cultural events. Check the current rule and exceptions before covering your face in public.
jurisdiction_scope: Nationwide; applies to everyone in covered public places and transport.
authority: Austrian Federal Legal Information System (RIS), Anti-Face-Covering Act, section 2
open_questions: The RIS page was available only as an indexed snippet in this pass. Fetch the current consolidated text, confirm exceptions and penalty, and check amendments before release.

finding: Thailand criminalizes criticism of the monarchy, and UK government travel advice warns that political comments or sharing online content interpreted as negative toward the institution can lead to prosecution. Do not assume online posts are exempt; check current Thai law and official guidance.
jurisdiction_scope: Nationwide; applies to conduct in Thailand. The cited FCDO advice is written for British nationals.
authority: UK Foreign, Commonwealth & Development Office
open_questions: Verify the current statutory text and scope with a Thai primary source before release; FCDO guidance is nationality-specific and does not resolve every interpretation.

finding: If using or carrying cannabis in Thailand, check the current medical-use rules and prescription documentation. UK government travel advice says use is restricted to medical purposes and requires a Thai-issued prescription limited to 30 days; do not assume a foreign prescription is sufficient.
jurisdiction_scope: Nationwide; the cited FCDO advice is written for British nationals and should be rechecked because cannabis rules can change.
authority: UK Foreign, Commonwealth & Development Office
open_questions: Confirm the current rule and whether a foreign prescription is accepted; cannabis export is a separate issue and is not used to characterize this possession alert.

finding: If carrying a drone into Thailand, check the NBTC registration requirement before travel: UK government advice says drones must be registered within 30 days of arrival or purchase in Thailand even if the traveler does not plan to fly them. This is a device-registration alert, not proof of import clearance.
jurisdiction_scope: Drones carried or purchased in Thailand; the cited FCDO advice is written for British nationals.
authority: UK Foreign, Commonwealth & Development Office
open_questions: Confirm the current NBTC process, timing, eligibility for foreign visitors and any separate CAAT flight requirements with Thai authorities.

finding: Thailand's government portal lists radio-communication and telecommunications equipment as restricted imports requiring an NBTC license. Check whether a device you plan to bring is covered before travel; ordinary consumer equipment and traveler exemptions were not established in this pass.
jurisdiction_scope: Radio-communication and telecommunications equipment entering Thailand; device coverage and traveler exemptions need confirmation.
authority: Thailand.go.th government portal, citing Customs Act B.E. 2560
open_questions: Confirm which personal devices require a license, traveler exemptions and the current licensing process with NBTC or Customs; the page was last updated in 2023.

finding: Thailand's government portal lists obscene books, images, printed materials, photographs and films among prohibited imports and exports. Check the legal classification before packing potentially restricted media; this is not a blanket ban on ordinary books or images.
jurisdiction_scope: Items classified as obscene under Thai law entering or leaving Thailand; classification is item-specific.
authority: Thailand.go.th government portal, citing the Customs Act B.E. 2560
open_questions: Confirm the current statutory definitions and application to particular material with Thai Customs; the source is a partial list and was last updated in 2023.

finding: Malaysia's Ministry of Health lists a yellow-fever travel advisory dated 12 October 2022 and updated yellow-fever vaccination-centre information. If your route includes a yellow-fever-risk country, check the current certificate requirement with Malaysian authorities before departure; the exact rule is not confirmed here.
jurisdiction_scope: Arrivals whose route includes a designated yellow-fever-risk country; current country list, age exceptions and transit rules remain unverified.
authority: Ministry of Health Malaysia
open_questions: The MOH page returned 403 when fetched and the advisory is dated 2022. Confirm current risk-country list, certificate timing and exceptions from readable primary guidance before publication.

finding: Before carrying wildlife or wildlife products into or out of Peninsular Malaysia, check whether the species is listed under CITES and obtain any required permit. PERHILITAN says CITES permits are required for listed wildlife imports and exports and applications are submitted online.
jurisdiction_scope: Listed CITES wildlife and products; PERHILITAN's published remit is Peninsular Malaysia, so verify Sabah and Sarawak separately.
authority: Department of Wildlife and National Parks (PERHILITAN), Malaysia
open_questions: Confirm species coverage and the competent authority for Sabah and Sarawak; the alert does not establish that every wildlife item is prohibited.

finding: A Mount Kinabalu climb requires an advance reservation and climbing permit, and climbers must use a registered mountain guide. Check current availability, entry documents, eligibility and package conditions with Sabah Parks before making the trip.
jurisdiction_scope: Mount Kinabalu, Kinabalu Park, Sabah only.
authority: Sabah Parks, Malaysia
open_questions: Verify current dates, age/nationality categories, guide arrangements and permit conditions for the intended climb; this is a site-specific alert, not a general Malaysia park rule.

finding: UK driving-licence holders need both their UK licence and a 1949 International Driving Permit to drive in Malaysia; obtain the IDP before travel. This guidance does not establish requirements for other licence holders.
jurisdiction_scope: UK driving-licence holders only; requirements for other nationalities are not established here.
authority: UK Foreign, Commonwealth & Development Office
open_questions: Confirm the requirement with Malaysia's Road Transport Department and do not generalize it to non-UK licence holders.

finding: Malaysia treats possession and trafficking of illegal drugs, including cannabis, as serious offences; even small quantities can lead to arrest, imprisonment and other severe penalties. Do not carry items for other people, and verify that prescribed medicines are lawful before travel.
jurisdiction_scope: Nationwide, including transit through Malaysian airports; FCDO advice is written for British nationals.
authority: UK Foreign, Commonwealth & Development Office
open_questions: Check Malaysia's current primary rules for prescribed controlled medicines; FCDO reports severe penalties but is not a substitute for substance-specific authorization advice.

finding: Before carrying prescribed narcotic or psychotropic medicines across Portugal's border, check the current personal-use limits and medical-document requirements with Portuguese authorities. A secondary travel source reports a 30-day limit, but that figure was not confirmed from readable primary text and is not stated here as settled law.
jurisdiction_scope: People crossing Portuguese borders with prescribed controlled medicines; exact categories and limits remain unverified.
authority: Diário da República, Portugal; implementing regulation page was not readable in this pass
open_questions: Read the applicable primary provisions and confirm any quantity limit, medical document, Schengen certificate and visitor applicability before publication; the reported 30-day figure is secondary-only.

finding: Do not bring radio-frequency jammers or counter-drone signal disruptors into Canada without a specific ministerial exemption. ISED says the law prohibits importation of these devices, subject only to limited exemptions.
jurisdiction_scope: Nationwide; applies to importation of jammers and devices that disrupt or spoof radiocommunications.
authority: Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada (ISED)
open_questions: Confirm whether a specific device is legally a jammer and whether an applicable ministerial order exists; exemptions are narrow and case-specific.

finding: Canada Customs may detain material suspected of being obscene or hate propaganda for an item-specific determination. Check the applicable legal definition before packing borderline material; the CBSA memorandum describes review procedures, not a blanket ban on ordinary publications.
jurisdiction_scope: Imports into Canada; classification depends on the specific material and legal criteria.
authority: Canada Border Services Agency (CBSA), Memorandum D9-1-17
open_questions: Review current CBSA determinations and the statutory definitions before publication; do not imply that ordinary material is targeted or automatically prohibited.

finding: Secretly observing or recording someone where they reasonably expect privacy can be a criminal offence in Canada, including recording by camera or other electronic means. Do not make hidden recordings in private circumstances.
jurisdiction_scope: Nationwide; applies to surreptitious observation or recording in circumstances meeting the Criminal Code test.
authority: Department of Justice Canada, Criminal Code section 162
open_questions: Apply the statutory elements and defences to the facts; this is not a blanket prohibition on photography in public.

finding: In a Canadian national park, do not wilfully remove, deface, damage or destroy prehistoric or historic artifacts or structures. A permit exception is limited to removal for public display in a museum.
jurisdiction_scope: National parks of Canada only; this regulation does not cover every provincial or municipal heritage site.
authority: Department of Justice Canada, National Parks General Regulations section 14
open_questions: Check park-specific rules and confirm whether any separate permit or Indigenous cultural-site protections apply to the location being visited.

finding: Canada's Criminal Code makes certain public incitement of hatred and wilful promotion of hatred against identifiable groups criminal offences, subject to statutory defences and exceptions. Avoid assuming that public statements are unrestricted.
jurisdiction_scope: Nationwide; the exact offence depends on the communication, context and statutory tests.
authority: Department of Justice Canada, Criminal Code section 319
open_questions: Review current text, definitions and defences with the 2026 amendments before publication; this is not a blanket ban on criticism or religious speech.

finding: Do not possess, install or use a radio-frequency jammer or counter-drone signal disruptor in Canada without a specific ministerial exemption; ISED says these activities are prohibited.
jurisdiction_scope: Nationwide; applies to possession and operation of devices that disrupt radiocommunications.
authority: Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada (ISED)
open_questions: Confirm whether a specific device is legally a jammer and whether an applicable ministerial order exists; importation is tracked separately under ELECTRONICS.

finding: A Gwaii Haanas visit requires an advance reservation at least five business days before the trip and a mandatory online orientation. Carry the booking receipt and proof of orientation while in the protected area.
jurisdiction_scope: Gwaii Haanas National Park Reserve, National Marine Conservation Area Reserve and Haida Heritage Site only.
authority: Parks Canada
open_questions: Check current seasonal reservation windows and fees for the intended dates; the page states that tour-operator visitors arrange reservations and orientation through their operator.
proposed_traveler_alert: Arrange a reservation and complete the visitor orientation before entering Gwaii Haanas. For a guided trip, arrange these through your tour operator.

finding: Do not carry cannabis or cannabis-containing products across Canada's border in either direction without specific Health Canada authorization. This applies even when cannabis is legal at the origin or inside Canada.
jurisdiction_scope: All Canadian border crossings, entering or leaving; authorization is a narrow exception.
authority: Canada Border Services Agency (CBSA)
open_questions: Confirm the exact statutory authorization and current penalties; this supplements, rather than replaces, general baggage and customs guidance.
proposed_traveler_alert: Leave cannabis and CBD products at home when crossing into or out of Canada. If you need a cannabis-based prescription, check with Health Canada and the authorities for every destination and transit country before packing.

finding: Polish law generally prohibits consuming alcohol in public places, but municipalities may designate specific exceptions. Use licensed premises and check local signs or municipal rules before drinking in public.
jurisdiction_scope: Nationwide general rule, subject to local designated exceptions.
authority: Official Legal Information System of Poland (ELI), consolidated alcohol-control statute
open_questions: The consolidated text checked dates to 2023; confirm later amendments and current local exceptions before publication.

finding: Poland restricts photographing or filming certain military and special-service facilities when they display an official no-photography sign; check posted notices and obtain permission where required.
jurisdiction_scope: Nationwide, but only at facilities marked with the statutory prohibition sign.
authority: Polish Armed Forces information page; cites the Homeland Defence Act
open_questions: The official page could not be fetched in this pass. Retrieve the current statutory text, exact scope, penalty and exceptions before publication.

finding: The Netherlands bans face coverings that make a person unidentifiable in or around government, healthcare and education buildings and inside public-transport vehicles. The transport ban does not apply to stops, platforms or stations.
jurisdiction_scope: Nationwide; applies to visitors and other people in the specified locations.
authority: Government of the Netherlands
open_questions: Check the law's exceptions and the precise boundary around facilities before publication; this is a partial-location ban, not a general public-space ban.

finding: Saudi Arabia's Public Decorum Charter says visitors in public places must dress modestly and must not wear outfits with images, signs or phrases that violate common decency. Check the charter and current penalty table before travel.
jurisdiction_scope: Visitors in public places across Saudi Arabia.
authority: Saudi Tourism eVisa portal, Public Decorum Charter
open_questions: The portal does not identify every detailed standard; read the current penalty table and underlying regulation before quoting specific clothing penalties.

finding: If carrying a drone into Saudi Arabia, confirm GACA registration and customs-clearance requirements before departure. GACA's FAQ search result says customs clearance cannot be requested without approved unmanned-aircraft registration; tourist eligibility remains unconfirmed.
jurisdiction_scope: Drone import into Saudi Arabia; registration scope and visitor eligibility need confirmation.
authority: General Authority of Civil Aviation (GACA), Saudi Arabia
open_questions: The official FAQ could not be fetched directly. Confirm the current registration, import procedure, foreign-visitor eligibility and any customs permit before publication.

finding: Before carrying narcotic or psychotropic prescription medicines into or out of Saudi Arabia, apply for the SFDA traveler clearance permit through the Controlled Drugs System and prepare the requested prescription or medical evidence.
jurisdiction_scope: Travelers arriving in or departing from Saudi Arabia with controlled narcotic or psychotropic medicines.
authority: Saudi Food and Drug Authority (SFDA)
open_questions: Confirm the medicine's classification, required documents and current application timing in the SFDA Controlled Drugs System before travel.
proposed_traveler_alert: Before bringing a medicine containing a controlled narcotic or psychotropic substance into or out of Saudi Arabia, check the exact ingredient and apply through the Saudi Food and Drug Authority’s Controlled Drugs System. Prepare the documents that show medical need.

finding: Before visiting a protected area in Saudi Arabia, check whether the area requires an entry or transit permit. The official regulation lists entry or transit without a required permit as a violation with a stated fine range.
jurisdiction_scope: Protected areas designated by the competent Saudi authority; permit requirements vary by location.
authority: Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA), Executive Regulation for Protected Areas
open_questions: Confirm the current designated-area list, permit process and applicable fine with the authority; the linked PDF was not text-readable in this pass.

finding: Croatia's public-order law contains offences for certain indecent or offensive conduct and disturbances of public peace. A 2023 official amendment changed the penalty schedule; check current local rules and penalties before travel.
jurisdiction_scope: Nationwide; exact conduct and penalty depend on the statutory provision and circumstances.
authority: Official Gazette of the Republic of Croatia (Narodne novine)
open_questions: The official amendment PDF was not text-readable in this pass; confirm the relevant article, penalty amounts and any later amendments before publication.

finding: In Dubrovnik's historic core, reports say walking in swimwear or topless can lead to a fine under local communal-order rules. Check current city signs and rules before walking from the beach into the old town.
jurisdiction_scope: Dubrovnik's protected historic core only; other Croatian towns may have different rules.
authority: City of Dubrovnik communal-order text; current reports are secondary and the linked consolidation is dated
open_questions: Read the current bylaw article and confirm the euro fine, boundaries and warning practice; do not generalize to all Croatian towns.
